entries.name: Trout and char daily quota
entries.regs_verbatim: Region 2 Daily Quotas. Trout/char: 4, but not more than 1 over 50 cm (2 hatchery steelhead over 50 cm allowed), 2 from streams (must be hatchery), 1 char (bull trout, Dolly Varden, or lake trout), none under 60 cm. And you must release: Wild trout/char from streams, All wild steelhead, Hatchery trout/char under 30 cm from streams. NOTE: There is no general minimum size limit for trout in lakes.

rules.review_reason: User ruling 2026-10-01: steelhead rules bind STREAMS only — the province's only in the regions whose own tables name steelhead (1, 2, 3, 5, 6) — and never a lake unless the lake's own row mentions steelhead (big lake rainbow fall under the rainbow size quota, not the steelhead quota). The book prints this rule for the whole region. Bound to streams by `feature_types: [stream]` only — no `water`, so its competition key (and every stream answer) is unchanged.

rules.verbatim: 1 char (bull trout, Dolly Varden, or lake trout)

rules.review_reason: User ruling 2026-10-01 (third): the wild-steelhead release binds STREAMS of the zone's own area (`feature_types: [stream]`, no `water`, so its competition key is unchanged) — 295c4ac3's reading of "lakes and streams" as every lake is reverted. A lake gets it only when its own row names steelhead (Khartoum and Lois lakes, through this rule's twin `<id>b`).

User ruling 2026-10-02: a lake (or other non-stream water) a STEELHEAD ROW is written for or binds — by any rule of a water row that names steelhead, flags anadromous rainbow or prints the Steelhead Stamp — gets its region's zone steelhead release too (Tenas Lake, by the Atnarko/Bella Coola spring closure, gets Region 5's; Khartoum and Lois get Region 2's). The same line as trout_char_quota.r7, bound to the book-known steelhead LAKES (and wetlands) inside the zone's own area that trout_char_quota.r7 does not bind (op steelhead_waters: the reach builder's book-known set, never the curated steelhead list, within area:region:2, lakes and wetlands only — a stream piece answers to the zone it is homed in, which trout_char_quota.r7 already decides — minus trout_char_quota.r7's sections). A rule of its own because a non-area extent on trout_char_quota.r7 would rank it as a water rule on every stream it binds (`read.source_of`) and change its competition key; no `water`, as trout_char_quota.r7 has none.

rules.verbatim: Hatchery trout/char under 30 cm from streams
NOTE: There is no general minimum size limit for trout in lakes
